language: "Panjabi"

poet: "Hasnain"

---

Ghar Nabi De Aaya Haider
Lara Nabiyaan Banaya Haider.

1
Paya Sehra Maula Ameer Aye.
Sohnra Saj Gaye Shiyaan Da Peer Aye.
Qadam Mubarak Uthaya Haider.

2
Asad Di Bachri De Baal Wanjraan Aye.
Farishtiyan Jinj De Naal Wanjraan Aye.
Aye Janjiyaan Nu Dasaya Haider.

3
Esa Mosa Khalil Aa Gaye.
Wila De Sare Wakeel Aa Gaye.
Madine Kaba Bulaya Haider.

4
Pak Zahra Da Taj Aaya.
Nibha Ke Rasma Rawaj Aaya.
Hai Gana Shagna Da Paya Haider.

5
Atta Aye Hasnain Te Thayi Aye.
Ali Di Shadi Jo Main Likhi Aye.
Karam Aye Sara Kamaya Haider.

from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/ghar-nabi-de-aaya-haider-lyrics-in-punjabi-2023-tajpoints-bf67881166586f02a3ca.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + p], text=True).split('---', 2)[2]
_, meta, source = Path(p).read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
normalize = lambda s: re.findall(r'\\w+', s.casefold())
assert normalize(old) == normalize(roman)
groups = lambda s: [block.splitlines() for block in re.split(r'\\n\\s*\\n', s.strip())]
r, s = groups(roman), groups(source)
assert [len(b) for b in r] == [len(b) for b in s] == [2, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4]
assert [b[0] for b in s[1:]] == list('۱۲۳۴۵')
assert all(line.startswith('  ') for line in roman.splitlines() if line)
print('Verified Roman wording, two opening verses and five matching three-verse stanzas.')

item.text:
Reconstructed “Ghar Nabi De Aaya Haider” in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both versions contain two opening verses and five three-verse stanzas.

Updated the titles and script metadata and removed the `noUrdu` tag. The Roman spellings “Wanjraan” and “Thayi” are ambiguous. I rendered them as ونجران and تھئی.
